criteria.text: Larger thiosulfate sink delays iodine accumulation

gross I2 from S4O6 formed 2.27e-5 vs 2.22e-5; surviving I2 0 both

first_round.observed_result: Over 100 s neither arm accumulated iodine; tetrathionate 2.27e-5 vs 2.22e-5 mol, thiosulfate left 2.4e-5 vs 9.0e-5 mol, acid decomposition gave S/SO2 3.0e-5 vs 6.5e-5 mol.
